gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR;
question_ru: Найдите количество матчей за каждый год.
question_en: Find the number of matches happened in each year.

ru.explanation: Запрос возвращает количество матчей для каждого года.

en.sql: SELECT YEAR ,  COUNT(*) FROM MATCHES GROUP BY YEAR

gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name ,  COUNT(*) FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Name;

ru.explanation: Запрос возвращает имена учителей и количество курсов, которые они преподают.

en.sql: SELECT T2.Name ,  COUNT(*) FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id  =  T2.teacher_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id
en.explanation: Запрос возвращает имена преподавателей и количество курсов, которые они ведут.

gold_sql: SELECT  T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question_en: What is the name of the course with the most students enrolled?

en.sql: SELECT T1.course_name FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_enrolment_courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
en.explanation: Запрос возвращает название курса с наибольшим количеством записавшихся студентов.

gold_sql: SELECT T1.countryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country GROUP BY T1.countryId HAVING count(*)  >  3 UNION SELECT T1.countryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T3 ON T2.Id  =  T3.Maker WHERE T3.Model  =  'fiat';
question_ru: Каковы id и названия стран, в которых имеется более 3 производителей автомобилей или которые производят модель «Fiat»?
question_en: What are the id and names of the countries which have more than 3 car makers or produce the 'fiat' model?

ru.sql: SELECT T1.CountryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country WHERE T2.Maker  =  'Fiat' UNION SELECT countryid ,  countryname FROM countries GROUP BY countryid HAVING count(*)  >  3
ru.explanation: Запрос возвращает идентификаторы и названия стран, где есть более трех производителей автомобилей или есть производитель Fiat.

en.sql: SELECT T1.CountryId ,  T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country WHERE T2.id IN ( SELECT maker FROM model_list WHERE model  =  'fiat' ) UNION SELECT countryid ,  countryname FROM countries GROUP BY countryid HAVING count(*)  >  3
en.explanation: Запрос возвращает идентификаторы и названия стран, которые имеют более трех производителей автомобилей или производят модель 'fiat'.

gold_sql: SELECT grade FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING count(*)  >=  4;

en.sql: SELECT grade FROM highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING count(*)  >=  4

gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  sum(T2.Sales) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name;

gold_sql: SELECT T1.Id ,  T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.Id ,  T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T3 ON T2.model  =  T3.model GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >  3;
question_ru: Каковы id и марки машин всех автопроизводителей, которые производят как минимум 2 модели и более 3 автомобилей?

ru.sql: SELECT T1.maker ,  T2.make FROM model_list AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.model  =  T2.model GROUP BY T1.maker HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.maker ,  T2.make FROM model_list AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.model  =  T2.model GROUP BY T1.maker HAVING count(*)  >  3
ru.explanation: Запрос возвращает марки и модели автомобилей, производимые как минимум двумя, так и более тремя моделями.
